decisions.reason: As an organic extension of the firm’s established sliced salami range that remained on the website across 2023 and 2024, it fits existing know-how well and gives management enough familiarity to improve and market it further.

This premium salami snack is very close to the firm’s core salami capabilities and is still present in 2024, so despite slightly weaker visibility than at launch the firm is likely to retain it and learn from early market response.

Organic boiled sausage builds directly on the firm’s traditional processing and seasoning knowledge and supports its stated organic expansion, making continued commercialization more likely than withdrawal after only one year.

The organic thinly sliced chicken breast line is adjacent to the existing cold-cut business and strategic organic push, but as a newer poultry-based offer it carries somewhat more demand uncertainty even though the firm has enough related knowledge to keep developing it.

Organic herb-coated salami is a close-to-core flavor variation that the firm can readily assess and refine using its existing salami and seasoning expertise, so it is more likely to be kept than dropped.
